result.description: The LumenForge ArcDesk 27 is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for studio dashboards, data walls, and ambient control rooms. It features a 2560x1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, DisplayPort 1.4, and an adjustable matte silver stand. Built for general productivity rather than gaming or storage use, it emphasizes wide viewing angles and low blue-light operation.
